field: content_html (asthma treatment paragraph) + practice_questions mark scheme (Q4)
wrong_text: up to 10 puffs, one puff every minute
problem: NHS and St John Ambulance UK both specify one puff every 30 to 60 seconds, not one puff every minute. This is the standard taught in all UK first-aid courses and the figure that would appear in OCR mark schemes. Administering one puff per minute is slower than recommended and technically incorrect. Source: St John Ambulance (https://www.sja.org.uk/first-aid-advice/asthma-attack/) and NHS (https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/asthma/).
correction: up to 10 puffs, one puff every 30 to 60 seconds
